# Proustite powder

Type: Material | Internal ID: ProustitePowder | Source: Lava Blob, ,, Unstable lava rock | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Proustite Powder is an item. Proustite has an adamantine to glassy luster, giving it a shiny, glassy appearance when viewed in reflected light.

## Availability

• Dropped by Lava Blobs and Unstable lava rocks in the Ashlands.

### Building

• Lava lantern

### Crafting

• Basalt bomb
• Blob bomb Lava
• Explosive payload
• Staff of Fracturing
